run_pipeline_generation: run BlipDiffusionControlNetPipeline to generate subject-driven images from a reference image and canny edge conditioning image
build_prompt_amplification: build amplified prompts by repeating a target subject prompt multiple times using _build_prompt method
encode_prompt_with_query_embeds: encode text prompts with QFormer query embeddings using encode_prompt to get text embeddings for the UNet
prepare_control_image: prepare and preprocess a conditioning image for ControlNet using prepare_control_image with classifier-free guidance support
get_query_embeddings: get multi-modal query embeddings from a reference image and source subject using the QFormer model
